scope: English phrase-based cue analysis; no phishing classification
limitation: Textual cues are prompts for review, not proof of phishing. No matches does not mean safe. Sender identity, links and attachments are not verified.

urgency.label: Time pressure
urgency.mechanism: A short deadline may encourage action before the request is checked.
urgency.check: Pause and confirm the deadline through a contact channel you already trust.
urgency.caveat: Legitimate reminders and time-sensitive work can contain the same wording.

authority.label: Claimed authority
authority.mechanism: A reference to a senior role or trusted team may encourage compliance.
authority.check: Confirm who sent the request using an independently known contact.
authority.caveat: Mentioning a role is not evidence of impersonation; this tool cannot authenticate a sender.

threat.label: Threatened consequence
threat.mechanism: A threatened loss of access or money may pressure the reader to comply.
threat.check: Check the account through its usual app or an independently obtained address.
threat.caveat: Genuine service notices can also describe account restrictions or consequences.

reward.label: Reward or special offer
reward.mechanism: An unexpected benefit may encourage engagement before its conditions are checked.
reward.check: Verify the offer independently, especially before sharing information or paying.
reward.caveat: Legitimate promotions may use similar language; an offer alone does not establish fraud.
